title: Preserve ClearFront UI prototype and prepare continuity QA packet
description: Preserve Claude’s current ClearFront side-rails prototype outside volatile scratch storage and create a durable continuity/QA packet covering locked operator feedback, prototype state, user-supplied asset readiness, baseline evidence, post-integration checks, and a collision-free handback. Do not modify ClearFront production HTML, CSS, JavaScript, game mechanics, or source provenance.
acceptance_criteria: The preserved prototype is byte-identical to Claude’s latest scratchpad file and its source path, timestamp, size, and SHA-256 are recorded.
The continuity packet distinguishes already-applied prototype changes, outstanding operator corrections, known asset mappings, asset-readiness limitations, and decisions that must not be inferred.
The packet records the green pre-integration automated-test baseline and defines observable desktop, mobile, interaction, readability, asset, and regression checks with evidence destinations.
Only the two registered continuity outputs are added; ClearFront production code, mechanics, and governing source files are untouched.
